method: Actual PossibilityScoringShogiGame + existing AI perft, without evaluation/pruning/leaf TT/bulk. Move-list cache within one traversal retained as production; a fresh game wrapper for each traversal prevents cross-run cache reuse. Native perft retains its production scoped generation cache and clears it on return. Identical starting rules/depth per pair; AI counts command steps, Native counts completed turns. Multi-hop leaf differences retained and explicitly reported, not relabeled as same work. Node and Native alternate three >=3s samples; setup/import/init excluded.
samplingNote: First five stable rules: >=3s warmup and >=3s samples. Remaining rules: >=10s warmup and >=5s samples after Chu timing instability. Each pair uses identical sample duration. All retain three alternating samples.
comparisonLimitations: Haitaka runs as optimized Native Rust; All-rounder runs as its unmodified PossibilityScoringShogiGame and existing perft in Node.js. Language/runtime and full implementation costs are included.

AI counts one command per ply; Haitaka counts completed turns. At the selected shallow depths, Dai Dai and Tai have different leaf counts and are reference throughput values, not equal-tree speed comparisons. Other selected rules have equal observed leaf counts; deeper multi-hop trees can differ.
Depths are newly chosen for this comparison and differ from the preceding all-historical deep Native benchmark.
